other_notes: Not quoted (explicit): edge protectors (L23, L24), pallet sleeves (L29) and void-fill rolls (L30) - 'sourced locally by our partners'; supplier offers to include them in a second round.
Prices are in USD, with invoices in USD. Exchange rate risk is with the buyer.
Payment is 30 days from bill of lading against irrevocable LC. Supplier declines 60-day payment terms.
Supplier is based in Singapore, with an India warehouse at Sriperumbudur, Chennai. Goods are converted ex-Singapore and delivered cleared to Hosur, with import duties included.
The ISO 9001 certificate is not attached; the supplier says 'to follow'.
Supplier's quoted BCT/ECT reports are per shipment, whereas the RFQ asks for every batch.
No BCT values, GSM or flute specs are confirmed for most carton lines. Prices are given by size and ply only.
Supplier letter date: 31 October 2026. Validity is 45 days.
extraction_warnings: L8 vs L14: the 'heavy-duty 450x300x300 mm' USD 0.440 line is ambiguous. It has been mapped to L14 with low confidence, and L8 (5-ply printed master carton) is left unpriced.
L26: the printed tape is priced per box but the pack size is not stated. The 36-roll pack size applies only to the clear tape, so basis_quantity is left null.
L2 and several other carton prices have no explicit 'per piece' wording. Per piece is inferred from the paragraph context (¶8 and ¶9 'all per piece').
Q2 and Q3 answers differ from what was asked: reports are per shipment rather than per batch, and capacity is across a regional network.
